title: 유한책임신탁등기규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02560:20141002:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Commercial Registration Rules) <No. 2560, October 2, 2014>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on November 21, 2014.
Article 2 Omitted.
Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules) (1) through (3) Omitted.
(4) Part of the Rules on Registration of Limited Liability Trusts shall be amended as follows:
In Article 8, "Articles 15, 35, 45 through 52, 57, and 61 through 66 of the Commercial Registration Rules" shall be replaced with "Articles 14 (1), 33, 43 through 50, 63, and 67 through 71 of the Commercial Registration Rules."
(5) through (8) Omitted.
Article 4 Omitted.
